preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^5.
The length of the binary string is 2*N, where N is between 1 and 10^5.
The binary string S contains only '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: output is either a list of N indices or -1
postconditions.description: The output is a list of N indices in increasing order if a valid partition exists, otherwise -1.

postconditions.expression: valid partition means P and Q are subsequences of S of length N and each character belongs to exactly one of P or Q
postconditions.description: A valid partition is defined by the conditions that P and Q are subsequences of S of length N, each character in S is included in exactly one of P or Q, and P and Q are not equal.
